text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH, here it comes, here it comes!
The day has finally arrived...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Setting her sights on the world, El Condor Pasa!
'The Otherworldly Fugitive' Silence Suzuka!
And—'The Monster II' Grass Wonder!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A showdown of the century like this has got to make the headlines!
I can't afford to blink...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Spe-chan, over here, over here~♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Maruzen-san!
You came...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it really is such a thrilling race!
You'd be missing out if you didn't come to watch.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Rudolf♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Special Week, so you've come too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah-wah!? E-even the President...!?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Conveniently, one of the seats Maruzensky saved is still open.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This spot has a good view. You should come join me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah... u-um...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My, my, Spe-chan, no need to be shy, you know?
Come on, come with me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sure it'll be a race you can't take your eyes off of either.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt about it♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, long ago.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have already risen from the scorch of my immature flames.
All that remains is to spread these wings wide and soar.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Surpassing the "Other Dimension" and the "Monster Bird", straight to the top.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "The Phoenix" Grass Wonder, ready for action!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass!!
...I have been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, El.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Where is your usual grand proclamation?
Are you not going to deliver it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Now that we've come this far, words are no longer needed!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let us clash!
Upon the turf—putting everything on the line!!
